items.title: 🤖 OpenAI Astra 在十项长期数学难题上取得突破
items.title_zh: OpenAI Astra 在十项长期数学难题上取得突破
items.title_en: OpenAI's Astra Model Achieves Results on Ten Long-Standing Math Problems
items.summary: OpenAI's Astra model reportedly achieves new results on ten long-standing mathematics and theoretical computer science problems, with AI-generated proofs formalized in Lean and human-assisted write-up.

items.summary: NetBSD 11.0 has been released, bringing new kernel options, firewall improvements, and hardware support.

items.summary: ripgrep's musl binaries occasionally segfault during very-large searches, prompting community analysis and debate about musl's default allocator.

items.title: A Surveillance Treaty in Disguise: Canada Signs UN Cybercrime Convention
items.title_zh: 加拿大签署联合国网络犯罪公约引发监控担忧
items.title_en: Canada Signs UN Cybercrime Convention Amid Surveillance Concerns
items.summary: Canada quietly signed the UN Cybercrime Convention, which critics argue is a surveillance treaty in disguise, raising significant privacy concerns.

items.title: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731
items.title_zh: DeepSeek发布V4 Flash 0731，这是一款304B参数、智能体能力增强且性价比极高的模型。
items.title_en: DeepSeek's V4 Flash 0731 is a 304B-parameter model with enhanced agentic abilities and strong value.
items.summary: DeepSeek released V4 Flash 0731, a 304B parameter model with substantially enhanced agentic capabilities, ranked ahead of larger models and offering strong value-per-intelligence.

items.title: Stateless MCP has recaptured my interest (and inspired mcp-explorer and datasette-mcp)
items.title_zh: 无状态 MCP 2.0 重燃兴趣，催生新工具
items.title_en: Stateless MCP 2.0 Reignites Interest, Inspires New Tools
items.summary: Simon Willison explains how the Stateless MCP day rollout of MCP 2.0 (the 2026-07-28 spec) is the protocol's biggest change yet and has renewed his interest, inspiring tools like mcp-explorer and datasette-mcp.

items.title: How Symmetric Are the Insides of a Go Network? [R]

items.summary: KataGo's maintainer investigates how much Go-playing neural networks automatically learn orientation-independent internal representations under 8-fold data augmentation.

items.title: 三大唱片公司提议将 AI 歌曲挡在榜单之外

items.title_en: Major Labels Propose Barring AI Songs from Charts Unless 'Substantially Human-Created'
items.summary: Major record labels propose chart eligibility rules that would block AI-generated songs unless they are 'substantially human-created', pushing beyond mere labeling to require legal AI use and copyright-compliant training data.

items.summary: Google's new Android 16 developer verification system requires sideloaded app developers to register, with paid and free tiers, raising privacy and censorship concerns.
